theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_graph_boundary_weak_derivatives
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s h : ℝ) (G : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < n → BoundaryVanishes T → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, u v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h) → {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + k)) n) ⊆ {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} → T ω = ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) s, G v * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + k)) n) (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) → ∀ a : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) s → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) s, G v * fderiv ℝ a v (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = 0
